rv.q: Lion King is simply the most stunning eye candy to ever walk across the Proctors stage.
I can confirm that the recent Atlanta production has lost none of its power.
Those seeing the blockbuster for the first time are in for a treat and those making a repeat visit will not be disappointed, as the show's iconic costumes, masks and puppetry are as stunning as ever.
A quarter century on, there are still few productions that have so boldly embraced scale and experimentalism at the same time.

Comported with that Disney discipline (we all know it when we see it), the production is visually stunning enough to keep toddlers to the timeworn engaged for two and a half hours including a 15 minute intermission. Straz Center - Tampa, FL Deborah Bostock-Kelley, BroadwayWorld: Vocally, the show is...
After a while, the effect can be numbing.

cn.t: Critics hail The Lion King as a spectacular, immersive theatrical experience with breathtaking puppetry, costumes, and design that brings the African savanna to life, calling it a genuinely unmissable production.
